title: Waypoint expedition catalog
description: Single source of truth for every advertised trip. Pages, nav, i18n, CTAs, schema, and sitemap must derive from this file — they must not keep a private allowlist.

id.description: Stable slug used by /inquire/?dest= and CTA allowlists.

path.description: Public URL path. Socotra is /socotra/; everything else is /{id}-expedition/.

langFile.description: Translation module. Do not invent a second stem (maya vs maya-corridor, maghreb vs tunisia-algeria).

inquire.description: If true, the page must load inquire-cta.js and accept ?dest={id}.

heroImage.description: Filename must name the place, not the stock-photo vendor (no unsplash-*).

imageCountry.description: Country actually depicted. Must be one of `countries`. Catches Kyoto-on-Mongolia.

yearRound.description: PR #12: no specific departure month/year on cards or itineraries.
